name: three-point bending test
domain: 车辆轨道结构与数值方法
definition_zh: 以两端支承和中部加载考察试件受弯行为的试验。
usage_note: 这里用于简化等效不同基础连续支承和脱空状态。

complete_examples.text: The basement defects of the loose fill are created by naturally stacking discontinuously graded gravel (5–25 mm in size) in a loose state, with a uniform thickness of 100 mm, and naturally grouting with a cement paste with a water–cement ratio of 0.8, as shown in Fig. 3a. Considering that void formation in the basement is the result of long-term cumulative stress and hydraulic coupling effects on the loose fill layer, a three-point bending test is designed to simulate different basement states (continuous and void) using simplified equivalent models of the pav-ing structure specimens [34, 35].
